newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom shares drop in Tokyo on report of sale.
newsitem.headline: Telekom shares drop in Tokyo on report of sale.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Telekom AG fell up to 4.5 percent in Tokyo trading, after German newspaper Handelsblatt reported in its Wednesday edition the Bonn government might consider selling some if its Telekom shares.
The paper reported that the Bonn government wants to sell a portion of its nearly 75 percent stake in Telekom this year as part of efforts to pare back the budget deficit.
In late Tokyo trading Telekom shares were trading at around 2,770 yen down 110 yen.
A Telekom spokesman said that a decision on whether to sell shares or not must be made by the owner. The Finance Ministry was not immediately availble for comment on Wednesday morning.
Shares begin trading in Germany at 0630 GMT.
